# Overview

```{=html}
<div id="trm-pop-summary" class="trm-pop-cards"></div>
<div class="trm-pop-note">
Missing means that no compatible call was emitted for this sample. It is not
converted to frequency zero and must not be interpreted as confirmed absence.
</div>
```

# Genome-wide trajectories

```{=html}
<div class="trm-pop-toolbar">
  <label>Chromosome <select id="trm-pop-chrom"></select></label>
  <label>TE family <select id="trm-pop-family"><option value="">All</option></select></label>
  <label>Trend <select id="trm-pop-trend"><option value="">All</option></select></label>
  <label>Minimum observed samples <input id="trm-pop-min-observed" type="number" min="1" value="1"></label>
</div>
<p id="trm-pop-filter-note" class="trm-pop-muted"></p>
<div class="trm-pop-chart-wrap"><svg id="trm-pop-scatter" viewBox="0 0 1200 430" role="img" aria-label="TE frequency by genomic position and timepoint"></svg></div>
```

# Selected locus trajectory

```{=html}
<h3 id="trm-pop-selected-title">Select a point or table row</h3>
<p id="trm-pop-selected-note" class="trm-pop-muted"></p>
<div class="trm-pop-chart-wrap"><svg id="trm-pop-trajectory" viewBox="0 0 1200 430" role="img" aria-label="Selected TE frequency trajectory"></svg></div>
<div class="trm-pop-table-wrap">
  <table class="trm-pop-table">
    <thead><tr><th>Sample</th><th>Timepoint</th><th>Replicate</th><th>Frequency</th><th>Status</th><th>Filter</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody id="trm-pop-observation-body"></tbody>
  </table>
</div>
```

# Locus catalogue

```{=html}
<div class="trm-pop-table-wrap">
  <table class="trm-pop-table">

    <tbody id="trm-pop-trajectory-body"></tbody>
  </table>
</div>
```
